en: ...Eh? Did the Captain pick up\nsomething strange again?
Whoa, it's a gaudy ring... and\nthat stone looks so fragile.
Heh, let me see. This...\ndefinitely looks like it's about\nto go "ping"...
Look for the owner
Sell it
Try breaking it
The owner might really be\nlooking for it. But how should\nwe find them...?
Maybe there's a name written\non it? Hey, let me see that too.

No, no, no! I told you, no! If you
don't know the value of things
like this, you'll just get ripped
off.
For now, we have to start by\ninvestigating what kind of\nsubstance it is...
That's our Captain! So LOCK,\nso wild!
Wait a minute! I get the\ntemptation to destroy it, but\ncan't we investigate it first?
Oh, isn't that ring glowing?
Whoa! It's too bright!
Ugh, my eyes are spinning... So,\nwhere on earth are we?
C-Captain!

This is a nonsensical location!
Scans are ineffective!
Furthermore, I can't locate the
ship!
It's clearly an artificial place. It\nlooks more like ruins than a\ncity.

Gears are turning everywhere...
Well, it's all junk, but the level
of technology is quite
impressive!

Wh-what are you doing?! I
won't forgive you if you
interfere with my date with
Leenbell!
A-A ghost! Help me, Captain!!
Cardinal Peter, please step\nback! It is my duty to fight.
I even placed guards at the\nentrance... Just where did you\ncome from?!
Even if you ask where we came\nfrom... Hey, Captain, can you\nexplain this?
...It seems there's more to this\nthan meets the eye. Let's have\na little chat.
...Heh, so this little mushroom\nboy is the leader of this\nregion?
M-m-m-mushroom...
You came along to "inspect"\nthe area as my escort today,\ndidn't you, Cardinal Peter?
Y-y-yes! That is correct!
Oh? You seem a bit tense...\nAre you perhaps a little\nthirsty?
Here, have this. It's my special,\ndelicious juice! Go on, take a\nbig gulp.
Eh, may I drink it?
*Gulp, gulp, gulp*... Phew, it is\ndeliciou...
*Shink!*
C-Cardinal Peter... turned into a\ngiant!?
Hey! Welch, what did you do?
Oh no! I can't believe I mistook\nit for juice and gave him the\nprototype medicine, "Mad Bull"!
Yikes! He's coming this way!\nEve, run!
Hah-hah!! I'm going to protect\nLeenbell-san!

Not only did he get huge, but
he's completely lost control!
Honestly, he did that on
purpose, didn't he?!
Cardinal Peter! Answer me!
...No, it seems he won't listen.\nCan't we change him back?!

Hehehe... Just as I thought this
might happen, Big Sister has
prepared a special Item for
you!
Hey, come over here for a\nsecond!
Whoa! Where are you going?!

What are you doing in a place
like this... Why are you taking
off your clothes... Wait,
whaaat?!
Eve, help me! And Captain, you\nabsolutely, positively do NOT\nlook!
Eeeeek! What is with this\noutfit?!

An enhanced suit from Welch
Lab! I'll use this to fight and
settle this Mushroom Boy once
and for all!
Muhohohooo! Leenbell-saaan!\nLOVE MEEEEEE!!
If it's come to this, I have no\nchoice. Peter! I'm coming to\nsave you!
*Fshurururu~*
Cardinal Peter, wake up!
Mumble mumble... Good\nmorning...
Thank goodness... His size\nreturned to normal, too.
Hmph, I was always a big man,\nCardinal Peter...
Nuh! W-waaaah... Leenbell, that\ndress! Oh my! Ow!

Hmm, I didn't expect such
growth. Using the Lycanthrope
transformation mechanism on a
Human might be dangerous...
Hey, Welch... What were you\nthinking, making someone drink\na suspicious drug!?
Ah, it's not suspicious! I even\ntook a sip to test it myself.

I thought since Mushroom Boy
looks sturdy, he might be okay
with a quick binge... just
kidding.
I knew it, it wasn't on purpose!
I-I'm so sorry~!
If you're going to apologize, you\nshould be apologizing to Peter\nand Leenbell, not me!
I am truly, deeply sorry! As an\napology, I'll just give you the\npower suit as a present!
Eh... ah... yes!
Thank you so much!!! This is\nlike a dream... like an angel...!!
(He's actually happy...)
(Even though he's the one who\nwent through the worst of it.)
Eh? Did I just hear something?
(Crap!)
(Idiot, hide!)

...Leenbell and I will continue
our... inspection for a bit
longer. Everyone, please stay
safe.
Now, let's head back to the\nship... Wait, what? H-how are\nwe supposed to get back!?
Coro, can't you do something?\nLike, a quick teleport or\nsomething...
I-I don't have a convenient\nfunction like that!
You mean we're going to spend\nthe rest of our lives in a world\nwe don't even know!?
Noooo... I haven't even gotten\nmarried yet! Dad, I'm\nsooorryyyyy...
Welch, calm down. Maybe that\nring is the key?
T-that is!? It's my "Zenith Star"!
Is this the Mushroom Boy's?

That stone is a unique,
one-of-a-kind item belonging to
Cardinal Peter. ...Why do you
have it?

It's a very, very precious
treasure to me and everyone in
Basel! ...You'll give it back to
us, right?
Of course! I'm just glad the\nowner was found.
Huh? The ring is glowing...
Whoa! It's too bright!
W-what's happening to meee?!
...Huh? Is this our ship...?
Phew... I don't understand the\nlogic behind it at all, but we've\nreturned safely, Captain.
Heh heh heh...
We got the treasure!!
Why does Welch have it?! I'm\nsure I handed it over to Peter...
While everyone was fighting, I\nswapped it with an incredibly\nexquisite replica I made!
Honestly, you're so sneaky...

...The mark on their finger was
clearly the same shape as the
ring, so I knew right away who
the owner was.

This looks fragile. It would be a
shame if a precious treasure
broke so easily, wouldn't it,
little Mushroom Boy?

The one I made is so tough,
you could punch something
even while wearing a ring and
be perfectly fine, okay!
Ugh. I just felt a sudden chill...
This concludes the story of\nEnd of Eternity.

We plan to release various
other stories in the future.
Please look forward to our
upcoming Events.
